Independent acceptance/overlap decision remains with the caller. Source-only; no execution evidence.

event.summary: removed pane replay helpers do not serve terminal-host replay
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. TLDR: No established loss of screen fidelity for current terminal-host sessions from deleting old tmux capture normalization and pane-mode restoration tests.
